1.text: With the Rosary, the Christian people sits at the school of Mary and is led to contemplate the beauty on the face of Christ and to experience the depths of his love.
1.notes: St. John Paul II, Apostolic Letter Rosarium Virginis Mariae (2002), sec. 1. Used in Ch. 11, The Formation of Prudence, Prayer bullet (Redline 17). Fetched in two pieces; the summarizer limit prevented one-shot quoting.
